vorhaben.titel: One shortcode for twenty-seven computed values
vorhaben.satz: Dew point, apparent temperature, frost days and summer days, degree-day sums and the SPI drought index — all through a single shortcode, with not one figure worked out by hand.

vorhaben.titel: A short outage at Netatmo no longer costs a reading
vorhaben.satz: When the Netatmo service reports that it is busy, the plugin waits exactly as long as the server asks and then asks again — instead of writing a gap into the series.

vorhaben.titel: The encryption speaks up when it is not working
vorhaben.satz: A new status panel shows whether your credentials really are stored encrypted — and names the four reasons that can stop it from happening.

vorhaben.titel: Header colour and typeface are settings now
vorhaben.satz: The dark header bars and the font in use are picked on the appearance screen, instead of having to be hunted down in a stylesheet.

vorhaben.titel: The API key belongs in the header, not in the address bar
vorhaben.satz: The REST API accepts the key in the X-NAWS-Key header only. A secret in the address bar is written down by access logs, the Referer header, the browser history and every cache along the way. Calls using ?api_key= answer 401 from now on — if you use the API, switch over before you update.
Live cards and yearly comparisons can be dragged into place in the settings — and the list shows only what your page actually carries: switch a module off and its cards go with it.
